children: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Tuesday that Tokyo will communicate closely with the United States to achieve orderly foreign exchange markets, adding that there has been no change to its foreign exchange stance since the  two countries' recent joint intervention to prop up the yen.
